focus: Angle 5 — playbooks and READMEs against the runtime

findingDetails.title: Compiled-contracts README headline count is wrong and the same error appears twice more in the legacy README
findingDetails.evidence: compiled/README.md:19 says the directory 'stores the four flattened command contracts'; it stores three (deep-ai-council, deep-research, deep-review). The same document at :23 says the inventory 'is intentionally limited to the three commands registered with the contract compiler and renderer', and its own tree block at :29-36 lists three contracts plus manifest.jsonl and README.md. Object.keys(require(compile-command-contracts.cjs).COMMANDS) returns exactly three keys. legacy/README.md repeats the error at :13 ('the four compiler-managed deep commands') and :87 ('exactly these four body-to-contract pairings'), while :19 of that file says the directory 'stores three fallback command bodies' and its tree at :29-35 lists three.
findingDetails.impact: The wrong number is the first sentence a reader meets in the document the angle names as its highest-value target, and it is self-refuting within the same file, so a reader has no way to tell which statement is authoritative.
findingDetails.recommendation: Change 'four' to 'three' at compiled/README.md:19, legacy/README.md:13 and legacy/README.md:87. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Listed both directories, read the compiler's COMMANDS registry directly rather than inferring the roster, and compared each count sentence against the tree block in its own document.

findingDetails.title: Deep-review playbook asserts no automated test suite exists while 18 deep-review test files do, and attaches no test cross-reference
findingDetails.evidence: Line 610 reads 'No dedicated automated test suite currently exists for deep-review.' and the section then names documentation paths only. Eighteen test files carry the name or the reducer contract: eleven under system-deep-loop/runtime/tests/ (deep-review-reducers, deep-review-state-reducer, deep-review-state-contract, deep-review-deltas-contract, deep-review-ledger-schema, deep-review-projections-contract, deep-review-sealed-artifacts, deep-review-strategy-heading, review-depth-validator, review-depth-graph, review-depth-convergence), one under system-spec-kit/runtime/tests/deep-loop/review-depth-reducer, and six under system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/tests/ (deep-review-auto-restart-contract, deep-review-contract-parity, deep-review-reducer-schema, review-record-validation, review-reducer-fail-closed, review-research-paths). The packet also ships deep-review/scripts/tests/reduce-state-summary-fallback.test.cjs, documented in its own scripts/tests/README.md.
findingDetails.impact: A false negative terminates the search rather than merely omitting it, so an operator reading the section stops looking at a live 18-file suite. The two sibling playbooks that carry the section show the intended form: deep-research §15 names two spec-kit test files and deep-ai-council §16 maps nine test files to scenario IDs.
findingDetails.recommendation: Replace the assertion with a test cross-reference in the sibling form, at minimum naming the eleven runtime/tests files and the packet's own reduce-state-summary-fallback.test.cjs. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Enumerated every test file matching the packet name or its reducer contract across the tree, then executed the packet's own test to confirm it is live, then read both sibling playbooks to establish the intended section form rather than assuming one.

findingDetails.title: Legacy README presents a repository-wide command-reference checker as a local acceptance test with a guaranteed pass
findingDetails.evidence: Line 108 instructs running node .opencode/commands/scripts/validate-command-references.cjs with the expected result at :111, 'the checker reports that command references resolve cleanly'. Executed, it exits 1 and prints 'FAIL  10 unresolved command reference(s)', listing ten missing assets under .opencode/skills/sk-design/. None of the ten belongs to a deep-loop tree and the README's own subject resolves cleanly inside that run.
findingDetails.impact: Bounded: the document's subject is unaffected, but its stated expected result is unconditional while the command's scope is repository-wide, so the instruction cannot pass for any reason connected to this README.
findingDetails.recommendation: Scope the check to the deep-command trees, or state the known-failing surface explicitly. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.confidence: high on the fact, medium on the causal reading
findingDetails.scopeProof: Executed the cited command, read its exit status and full failure list, and confirmed none of the ten failures falls in the document's subject tree before filing rather than treating the non-zero exit alone as the defect.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Two hundred eighty-nine playbook documents plus five READMEs with a hundred-plus executable-command, path, count and validator-exit claims, every one of which had to be resolved by execution or exact-path test rather than by reading.
